entries.zh: 骗取他人钱财；讹诈、勒索
entries.en: to cheat a man of his money; to swindle or extort

entries.zh: 索取；以欺瞒手段强行讨取
entries.en: to demand and take by deceit; to exact
entries.notes: L 栏 'deseores' 疑为抄讹，义从 H/R '索取' 定。

entries.en: to extort by fraud; to wheedle and extort
entries.notes: L 栏 'despense' 不可解，义从 H/R '索騙' 定。

entries.zh: 引路诱捕；带路使人被官差擒拿
entries.en: to lure a man by leading the way so that he is arrested
entries.notes: L 'bilante' 疑指巡夜或官差；H 第三字'御'与 R 'zhū' 不合。

entries.zh: 煽惑；以言语煽动蛊惑，诱人入邪
entries.en: to incite and delude; to seduce by agitation

entries.zh: 骗光诈尽（如剃发后再挖净发根，喻分文不留）
entries.en: a thorough swindler; one who fleeces a man to the last hair (lit. shaves him and digs out the hair)
entries.notes: M 栏 T99 污损、L 严重讹写，仅据 H '剃人後挖毛' 之喻定'骗尽'。

entries.zh: 设局设套；张罗圈套诈人
entries.en: to lay a snare; to set a scheme against someone
entries.notes: H '句' 与 R 'guiò' 音不合，疑为'局'或'計'之讹；L 'hacer treça' 按设局解。

entries.zh: 另设圈套；在买卖交易中做局行骗
entries.en: to devise a fresh trick; to set a snare in a bargain
entries.notes: H 第二字同前条可疑；L 'conpracon' 当作 compraçión（买卖）解。

entries.zh: 瞒天欺人；表里不一的大骗子
entries.en: a false, double-dealing deceiver; one who 'deceives heaven'
entries.notes: M 栏 'qȳ' 残，H '瞞天' 与 R 'mōan tiên' 互证，L 余字不可解。

entries.en: to beget; to give birth; to be born
entries.notes: L 次词 'orar' 疑衍或讹，中文三栏皆作'生'。

entries.en: to give birth to a son (lit. 'play with the jade tablet')
to bear a child in old age; to beget a son late in life
entries.notes: M 栏后半 'chiēn guar' 不可解，R 栏亦残，依 H '晚生子' 与 L 定。
H/M/R 三栏皆空，仅存西语词头 engrandecer（增大、抬高、颂扬），中文对应无法确定。

entries.en: to paste; to smear with paste
entries.notes: H '稍'、R 'gui' 均与'涂糊'不合，疑栏位讹错；依 L 'Engrudar' 及本页糊浆诸条定。
M 栏 'ŝeabole' 残讹，H '漿' 与 R 'chiāng' 互证。

entries.zh: 薄浆；调稀的浆糊，薄薄涂浆
entries.notes: L 'mançana' 未能确解，'pocco'（poco）与小量、薄相合，余从 H/R。

entries.zh: 糊好并带置该处；涂糊后放到指定处
entries.en: paste it and put it there (at that place)
entries.notes: L 'aguy' 即 aquí；H '糊帶處' 按'糊好、带往该处'解。
